title: aegilops squarrosa subsp. typica
intro: Aegilops squarrosa subsp. typica, commonly known as Aegilops squarrosa, is a type of wild grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Asia, where it is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is reported to have therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, treating respiratory issues, and soothing gastrointestinal problems. Bioactive constituents present in Aegilops squarrosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
